| Company | 2017 Gross Profit (USD × 10⁶) | 2018 Gross Profit | 2019 Gross Profit | CAGR (2017‑2019) |
|---------|------------------------------|-------------------|-------------------|-----------------|

**Which company had the highest CAGR?**

\] |
| Dropbox | Consolidated Statements of Operations – 2019 10‑K (filed Feb 20 2020) | 2017 $800 M, 2018 $1,046 M, 2019 $1,251 M | \[
\text{CAGR} = \Big(\frac{1251}{800}\Big)^{1/2} - 1 \approx 0.25 \,(25\%)
\] |

Therefore, **HubSpot exhibited the highest compound annual growth rate in gross profit** among the three firms for the 2017‑2019 period.
